description: He wears an opaque cream long undertunic with patterned collar and cuffs under a long open burgundy noble coat with gold woven borders, short outer sleeves and refined small fastenings. A matching shoulder cloak attaches at round gold clasps. A decorated dark belt with round buckle and hanging ornate strap circles the waist. Dark trousers and tall brown leather boots are fully visible. No headgear, armor or weapon.
